kohs_anchors.screen.subtitle: Anchor and glowstone, exactly as you pressed them
kohs_anchors.option.anchor_debris.descri: Block debris particles of anchor explosions. Turning them off saves frames in anchor fights; other explosions keep theirs.
kohs_anchors.option.anchor_fade.descript: The anchor you detonate shrinks and sinks away over half a second instead of vanishing in one frame. Drawing only: the next anchor goes down in its place at once, and the fade stops the moment it does.
kohs_anchors.option.interface_motion.des: Floating particles, entrance effects, the animated anchor and the workshop's transitions on this screen.
kohs_anchors.stats.title: This session
kohs_anchors.footer.note: Every action is your own click. The server decides.
kohs_anchors.preview.hint: Drag: turn · Wheel: zoom · Click: charge
kohs_anchors.option.hide_detonating.desc: The anchor you detonate disappears the moment you click, instead of standing there until the server's explosion arrives. Drawing only: the block, its collision and what the server sees do not change, and it reappears at once if the server keeps it.
kohs_anchors.option.fast_chain.descripti: Clicks on an exploding anchor go out at once instead of waiting for the server to remove it, and the next anchor, its charge and its explosion are drawn at once. Only where the server's bridge allows it: the server knows, and its anticheat is told.
kohs_anchors.option.instant_detonation.d: A click that detonates an anchor is sent the moment you press it instead of on the next game tick (up to 50 ms sooner). Only where the server's bridge allows it.
kohs_anchors.option.anchor_debounce.desc: A second anchor placed with the same slot sooner than this after the last one is ignored: a double click, a bouncing switch or a held key no longer puts two anchors down. Switching slots ends the wait, and detonating is never slowed. Vanilla: no limit.
kohs_anchors.option.glowstone_debounce.d: The same for glowstone: a second charge or glowstone block with the same slot within this time is ignored, so a double click cannot charge twice or drop a glowstone block where the anchor just exploded. Vanilla: no limit.
kohs_anchors.option.core: Pressed order, fresh target, early clicks shown at once, no stacking, instant detonation, hidden detonated anchor
kohs_anchors.option.core.description: What made KoHs Anchor's land your clicks right is no longer optional: bursts land in the order you pressed them, one slot change per tick and before its clicks, as Vanilla sends them; clicks on an exploding anchor wait for the free block, and what they will do (the next anchor, its charge) is drawn the moment you press; double clicks never stack an anchor, and the explosion is heard and seen at once, the anchor drawn as gone until the server answers.
kohs_anchors.option.herzium.description: Herzium decides which hotbar key wins when several land in one tick; KoHs Anchor's plays anchor bursts in the order you pressed them, one slot change per tick, before its clicks. Herzium (last input) is the order recommended for anchors: the last key you press wins. Click to change Herzium's order; Herzium saves it in its own file.
kohs_anchors.option.herzium_old.descript: This Herzium applies a key pressed after a click before that click. KoHs Anchor's still plays anchor bursts in pressed order, but update Herzium to 1.10.6 or later for everything else. Click to change Herzium's order.
kohs_anchors.herzium.order.herzium.descr: The last key you press wins: 9 then 1 selects 1. The fastest for anchors.
kohs_anchors.herzium.window.title: Herzium × KoHs Anchor's
kohs_anchors.herzium.window.missing_body: With Herzium, KoHs Anchor's couples and prioritizes anchors: each anchor burst plays in the order you pressed it, and Herzium decides which hotbar key wins for everything else. Herzium has three orders: last input (the last key you press wins), Vanilla (the highest slot) and Vanilla reversed (the lowest). Last input speeds anchors up the most: the item you pick right before a click is the one that click uses.
kohs_anchors.herzium.window.body: Herzium decides which hotbar key wins when several land in one tick. KoHs Anchor's plays each anchor burst in the order you pressed it, one slot change per tick, and leaves every other key to Herzium's order. Start with last input: it is the fastest for anchors.
kohs_anchors.herzium.window.source: Herzium's own setting · read from %s · changed through Herzium
kohs_anchors.option.enemy_follows.descri: Their anchors shine with your Glow anchors settings: power, bloom, light on the surroundings and quality. Only the colour is theirs.
kohs_anchors.dev.enemy_follows.descripti: Every anchor is drawn with the one Glow: power, bloom, spill, emissive, pulse, quality. Draw.override replaces the colour of ENEMY anchors only.
kohs_anchors.option.enemy_colour_off.des: Their anchors glow like yours. Turn Enemy colour on in the Glow tab to see this colour in the world.
kohs_anchors.dev.enemy_colour_off.descri: Draw.override is not applied: ENEMY anchors take ownColor(charge).

kohs_anchors.kohs.role: KoHs Mod Suite is a one-person studio: every mod and plugin, its code, screens, art and updates, is made by Zymekoh. Tools that make Minecraft PvP sharper and better looking, built for fair play.
kohs_anchors.kohs.role_short: Every KoHs mod and plugin, its code, art and updates, made by one person for fair PvP.
kohs_anchors.footer.note.kohs: KoHs Mod Suite · made by Zymekoh
kohs_anchors.option.herzium_recommend.de: Herzium (last input): the last hotbar key you press wins, so the anchor, glowstone or sword key you press right before a click is the one that click uses. The fastest order for anchors.
kohs_anchors.option.herzium_source.descr: It is Herzium's own setting, read from its config file. KoHs Anchor's never writes that file and keeps no copy of the order: a change goes through Herzium, which saves it.
kohs_anchors.option.herzium_sync.descrip: KoHs Anchor's tells Herzium about the hotbar keys it applies itself in an anchor burst. When a burst goes on in the next tick with another item than the one Herzium's hotbar preview shows, that preview is dropped, so the hotbar shows the item in use. Never passed off as Vanilla's own selection, which Herzium would take as its own mistake.
kohs_anchors.option.herzium_guide.descri: What Herzium decides, what KoHs Anchor's decides, and Herzium's three orders.
kohs_anchors.dev.herzium_recommend.descr: HotbarOrder.HERZIUM, reached with Herzium's cycleHotbarOrder(); Herzium saves herzium.json itself.
kohs_anchors.dev.herzium_source.descript: HerziumConfig.get().hotbarOrder() by reflection; config/herzium.json, read only, when that cannot be reached.
kohs_anchors.dev.herzium_sync.descriptio: HotbarOrderController.hotbarClickConsumed after each press AnchorInput.replay consumes; at tick end, ImmediateHotbarInput.clearPreview when visualSelectedSlot differs from the burst's next slot. Never noteCallSiteSelection.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_enabled.descrip: Charged anchors give off light: their lit pixels shine, the light blooms around them and falls on the blocks nearby. Walls hide it; it never shows an anchor you could not see.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_source.descript: From the texture: each pixel glows in its own colour, the one your skin gives it. Custom: one colour for all of the light.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_color.descripti: The colour of the light when the glow colour is custom.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_power.descripti: How strong the whole glow is.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_bloom.descripti: The soft light around the lit pixels, shaped by them: four charge lights bloom as four.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_spill.descripti: The floor, walls and ceiling around the anchor lit in its colour. The light spreads through the air like the game's own: round corners and down the pillar an anchor stands on, fading as it goes.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_emissive.descri: The portal, the veins and the charge lights shine at full strength even in the dark.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_pulse.descripti: The light breathes slowly, each anchor on its own beat.
More light with every charge, as the anchor's own light level does.
kohs_anchors.option.enemy_enabled.descri: The anchors other players place glow in their own colour, picked at the end of this tab, and wear their own skin from the Skin tab, instead of yours.
kohs_anchors.option.crystal_colors.descr: Takes the anchor's colours and glow from KoHs Crystal Tweaks: the frame, the glow, each charge light and the enemy colour, translated for a stone block, and keeps them in step.
Every anchor charge you hear plays the sound below instead of Vanilla's.
kohs_anchors.option.sound_charge_pick.de: Any sound the game knows, including a resource pack's.
kohs_anchors.option.sound_explosion_cust: Every anchor explosion you hear, yours at the click and everyone's from the server, plays the sound below.
kohs_anchors.option.sound_explosion_pick: Any sound the game knows. Other explosions keep theirs.
kohs_anchors.option.sound_preview.descri: Plays the sound as you will hear it.
kohs_anchors.option.dev_mode.description: For development: names become the code behind them (classes, methods, mixins), an inspector opens at the top left (F12 hides it), and the mixins are listed here.
kohs_anchors.footer.note.anchor: Changes reach every anchor in the world at once.

kohs_anchors.crystal.result.synced: In step with KoHs Crystal Tweaks: change your crystal colours and the anchor follows.

kohs_anchors.dev.inspector.hint: Point at anything on this screen.
kohs_anchors.dev.anchor_debounce.descrip: MultiPlayerGameModeMixin @ useItemOn HEAD → AnchorDebounce.refuses(player, hand, hit): FAIL before any prediction or packet. Intent PLACE_ANCHOR; detonations are Intent.NONE. Window.start at RETURN; noteSelected ends it on a slot change. config anchorDebounceMillis.
kohs_anchors.dev.glowstone_debounce.desc: Same hook; Intent USE_GLOWSTONE for a charge (charge < 4) or a glowstone block; a full anchor is NONE. config glowstoneDebounceMillis.
kohs_anchors.dev.hide_detonating.descrip: RenderSectionRegionMixin @ getBlockState HEAD, SodiumLevelSliceMixin (@Pseudo, require 0) and VeiledOutlineMixin @ extractBlockOutline TAIL. Lifted by ClientLevelServerStateMixin @ setServerVerifiedBlockState, by DetonationPredictor.onAcknowledged @ handleBlockChangedAck, or after 1.5 s. config hideDetonating.
kohs_anchors.dev.core.description: replay() in pressed order at the first keyHotbarSlots read, one stretch per tick: after a click (tickSlot, set by MultiPlayerGameModeMixin), a slot change and the presses after it wait in Vanilla's counters (MinecraftMixin @ consumeClick) for the next tick. hold()/releaseHeld() for detonating anchors; drawHeld() draws a held anchor or charge at the press through AnchorVeil.predict when landsInPlace() (the ray leaves the anchor into a sturdy face in reach), taken back when the click is dropped; the wait follows Latency.answerWindowNanos(0.7 s, 1.5 s). mergesRepeat(), showAtInput() from KeyMappingMixin @ click TAIL. hideDetonating is core too. The core flags are transient: not saved.
kohs_anchors.dev.herzium_old.description: Reflection on dev.zymekoh.herzium.config.HerziumConfig.get().hotbarOrder() / cycleHotbarOrder(). Version below 1.10.6: its pass applies a key pressed after a click.
kohs_anchors.dev.herzium.description: Reflection on dev.zymekoh.herzium.config.HerziumConfig.get().hotbarOrder() / cycleHotbarOrder(). No runtime adaptation: KoHs consumes an anchor burst before Herzium's pass.
kohs_anchors.dev.interface_motion.descri: AnchorsUi.sigil/motes/comets/slash, AnchorWorkshop entrance, warnings' motion; time-based, System.nanoTime().
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_enabled.descriptio: LevelRendererGlowMixin @ submitBlockEntities TAIL → SubmitNodeCollector.submitCustomGeometry(GlowMaterial.glow()). AnchorTracker: server states, own placements, palette scan every 10 ticks. config glow.enabled.
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_source.description: SOURCE_TEXTURE: GlowGeometry runs keep each pixel's composed colour, spill uses SkinComposer.averageGlowColor. SOURCE_CUSTOM: Glow.color scaled by the pixel's luminance.
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_power.description: intensity = power/100 × (0.4 + 0.6 charge/4) × pulse × distance fade 48-64 blocks.
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_bloom.description: 8×8 cells + 2 border, Gaussian σ = 1.15 cells, normalised per face, faded below the base.
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_spill.description: Dijkstra from the anchor through open cells (26 neighbours, real step lengths, no slipping through edge cracks), light = window × 1/(1 + 0.24 (d − 0.5)²), reach 4.6; each face lit from the air in front, corners averaged like smooth lighting × (0.4 + 0.6 cos), halved faces.
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_emissive.descripti: Lit pixels merged into rows, drawn 0.0025 off the face.
kohs_anchors.dev.crystal_colors.descript: read() ← config/crystal_tweaks.json (visuals, glow, enemyVisuals); map() in OKLab: frame L 0.23, glow L 0.66, charge ramp L 0.62→0.86; apply() → Skin + Glow + EnemyGlow; syncIfChanged() on file time.
kohs_anchors.dev.sound_charge_custom.des: ClientPacketListenerMixin @ handleSoundEvent → @WrapOperation ClientLevel.playSeededSound, holder swapped when it is block.respawn_anchor.charge.
handleExplosion playLocalSound @WrapOperation for anchor explosions; DetonationPredictor.detonate → AnchorSounds.playExplosion.
kohs_anchors.dev.sound_explosion_pick.de: Any SOUND_EVENT key; resource pack sounds work too.
kohs_anchors.dev.fast_chain.description: AnchorInput.decide → RUN / RUN_PREDICTED / CATCH_UP / DROP; predictions drawn by AnchorVeil. Acts only where BridgeClient.allows(POLICY_FAST_CHAIN).
kohs_anchors.dev.instant_detonation.desc: KeyMappingMixin @ click TAIL: keyUse.consumeClick() → startUseItem between client ticks. Acts only where BridgeClient.allows(POLICY_INSTANT_DETONATION).
kohs_anchors.dev.dev_mode.description: DevInspector.node() per drawn element, render() at the end of the frame; F12 toggles the panel.
kohs_anchors.enemy.subtitle: Enemy anchors: the ones other players placed
kohs_anchors.option.enemy_about.descript: An anchor is an enemy's when it appears where you have no placement in flight. Anchors that were already there when you arrived glow like yours.
kohs_anchors.dev.enemy_about.description: A server state that turns a non-anchor into an anchor at a block with no own placement awaiting its acknowledgement (AnchorTracker.OWN_PENDING, cleared by handleBlockChangedAck). The header switch runs EnemySwitch; EnemyIntro the first time.
kohs_anchors.enemy.intro.title: Enemy anchors
kohs_anchors.enemy.intro.body: An enemy anchor is one that appears where you placed none: another player's. This page changes how those look to you, so in a fight you tell theirs from yours at a glance. Yours, and the ones that were already there, keep your look.
kohs_anchors.option.glowstone_guard.desc: In an anchor fight glowstone only charges anchors: a click that would put it down as a block is dropped, as if it had not been pressed. It rules out the safe anchor, which puts glowstone down on purpose: made for spamming. Only acts within 4 s of your last anchor action.
kohs_anchors.option.anchor_smoke.descrip: The smoke cloud of anchor explosions, which hides the other player in a chain: Vanilla, Light (one small puff) or None. Sound, flash and knockback are unchanged, and other explosions keep their smoke. Less smoke also means fewer particles to draw.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_quality.descrip: How much of the glow each anchor gets. Performance: coarser light, and bounce light for the 3 nearest anchors only. Balanced: full detail up close. Quality: full detail farther out. Anchors out of view and faces turned away are never drawn.
kohs_anchors.dev.glowstone_guard.descrip: useItemOn HEAD: glowstone whose use would place a block (not an anchor, or sneaking) within 4 s of an anchor action returns FAIL. Settings.glowstoneGuard.
kohs_anchors.dev.anchor_fade.description: DetonationPredictor.detonate → AnchorFade.start: a copy of the anchor shrinks, turns and sinks for 0.55 s, submitted with the block entities (LevelRendererGlowMixin). No block, no collision; it stops when the veil or the world shows an anchor there again. Enemy anchors fade in their skin (EnemySkinRenderer.submitCube). config anchorFade.
kohs_anchors.dev.anchor_smoke.descriptio: handleExplosion addParticle (anchor explosions only, DetonationPredictor.isAnchorExplosion) and the predicted detonation: EXPLOSION_EMITTER, one EXPLOSION, or nothing. Settings.anchorSmoke.
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_quality.descriptio: LOD distances {4,12,24} / {8,20,36} / {16,32,48}, bounce light for the nearest 3 / 8 / 16 within 10 / 16 / 24 blocks, vertex budget 40k / 90k / 200k. View cone and back faces always culled.
kohs_anchors.glowstone_warning.title: Before you turn it on
kohs_anchors.glowstone_warning.body: If you turn this on you can't safe anchor. It's meant for spamming. You've been warned.
kohs_anchors.glowstone_warning.no_video: The clip could not be played.
kohs_anchors.option.chain_moved.descript: The no-wait chain and the instant detonation click are on Anchors Server now: they only work where a server's bridge allows them.
kohs_anchors.option.bridge_status.descri: The KoHs Anchor's Bridge plugin on this server. With it the server allows the anchor chain and tells your anchors apart from the enemy's. In singleplayer it is built in.
kohs_anchors.option.bridge_check.descrip: Asks the server for its bridge again, with the falling anchor.
kohs_anchors.option.better_enemy_glow.de: The server says who placed each anchor, so an anchor of yours never shows as an enemy's and an enemy's never as yours, even when you both use the same hole.
kohs_anchors.option.bridge_latency.descr: Pings the server's bridge once a second for the real round trip, and every wait that depends on the connection uses it instead of the player list's figure.
kohs_anchors.option.bridge_plugin.descri: The server plugin, for Paper, Spigot, Bukkit, Purpur, Folia, Velocity and BungeeCord. Show its page to your server's admin.
kohs_anchors.footer.note.server: The server decides: its bridge, its rules.
kohs_anchors.enemy.off.body: Off: every anchor looks like yours. Turn it on to give the anchors other players place a look of their own.
kohs_anchors.bridge.check.title: Verifying the bridge
kohs_anchors.bridge.check.body: Verifying connection with the server bridge… %s
kohs_anchors.bridge.ok.title: Bridge connected
kohs_anchors.bridge.ok.local.body: Singleplayer: the bridge is built in, and everything is allowed.
kohs_anchors.bridge.fail.title: No bridge here
kohs_anchors.bridge.fail.body: This server (%s) does not allow the more aggressive optimization options or the advanced anchor features, because it has no KoHs Anchor's bridge. Ask its admin to install the plugin.
kohs_anchors.bridge.noapi.title: Fabric API needed
kohs_anchors.bridge.noapi.body: The bridge talks to the server through Fabric API. Install Fabric API to use it on this server (%s).
kohs_anchors.bridge.offline.title: Not on a server
kohs_anchors.bridge.offline.body: Join a server to check its bridge. In singleplayer it is built in.
kohs_anchors.entry.legit.title: KoHs Anchor's is legitimate
kohs_anchors.entry.legit.body: None of its features gives an anticheat a reason to flag you: without a server's bridge everything stays inside what Vanilla sends. The same packets, in Vanilla's order and tick shape, one press per click, nothing automated. Measured against Grim Anticheat in its strict setup: 0 alerts.
kohs_anchors.entry.legit.plugin: The advanced anchor options only work through its server plugin, where the server's admin allows them.
kohs_anchors.entry.legit.rules: Each server's own rules still come first. The audit explains every feature.
kohs_anchors.entry.more.title: Want more?
kohs_anchors.entry.more.body: More optimization and more anchor options come with the server's bridge. Talk to your server's admin, or ask them to install the KoHs Anchor's Bridge plugin: it also fixes common errors, like an anchor you placed showing up as an enemy's.
kohs_anchors.entry.more.enemy: And try “%s” at the top of the menu.
kohs_anchors.dev.chain_moved.description: fastChain / instantDetonation act only where BridgeClient.allows(POLICY_FAST_CHAIN / POLICY_INSTANT_DETONATION); LOCAL allows all.
kohs_anchors.dev.bridge_status.descripti: OFFLINE · NO_API · CHECKING (channel registered? HELLO → WELCOME) · CONNECTED · LOCAL (no ServerData) · MISSING (3 s without channel, 4 s without welcome).
kohs_anchors.dev.bridge_check.descriptio: Back to CHECKING on this connection; ServerCheckWindow plays the check.
kohs_anchors.dev.better_enemy_glow.descr: The plugin sends OWNER(pos, self/other) on BlockPlaceEvent for respawn anchors near the player; it overrides the acknowledgement heuristics.
kohs_anchors.dev.bridge_latency.descript: One ping a second, smoothed 0.7 / 0.3; used by AnchorVeil and the early clicks' answer windows.
